title: Flat tire removal and temporary-spare installation

requirements.display_name: Hard, level and stable work surface
Forester temporary spare wheel / tire assembly

actions.title: Secure the vehicle before changing the tire
actions.instruction: Move the vehicle completely off the road to a safe, hard and level location, apply the parking brake, select P, stop the engine, and turn on the hazard flashers.
actions.warning_text: Keep occupants away from the vehicle while it is supported by the jack.

actions.title: Chock the wheel diagonally opposite the flat tire
actions.instruction: Block the wheel diagonally opposite the flat tire to prevent the vehicle from moving.

actions.title: Retrieve the temporary spare, jack, and tools
actions.instruction: Open the rear cargo-floor storage and remove the temporary spare tire, jack, and wheel tools.

actions.title: Loosen the wheel nuts before jacking
actions.instruction: Loosen the flat wheel's nuts slightly before raising the vehicle. Do not remove them yet.

actions.title: Jack the vehicle at the designated point
actions.instruction: Position the jack at the designated jacking point nearest the flat tire and raise the vehicle only enough to remove and install the wheel.
actions.warning_text: Never get under the vehicle while it is supported only by the supplied jack.

actions.title: Remove the flat wheel
actions.instruction: Remove the wheel nuts and take the flat wheel off the hub.

actions.title: Install the temporary spare
actions.instruction: Install the temporary spare on the hub and hand-start all wheel nuts.

actions.title: Lower the vehicle and tighten the wheel nuts
actions.instruction: Lower the vehicle and tighten the wheel nuts evenly in the sequence specified by Subaru. Verify final tightness with the applicable Forester wheel-nut specification before normal driving.

actions.title: Stow the removed wheel and observe temporary-spare restrictions
actions.instruction: Secure the removed wheel and tools and confirm the temporary spare is properly inflated. Follow Subaru's temporary-spare operating restrictions until the normal tire is repaired or replaced.
actions.warning_text: The temporary spare is not a permanent replacement for the normal road tire.
